description: Approves 2026 Public Art Mentorship Program for emerging artists.
Seeks $8,500 for four mentors and eight mentees.
Proposal goes to Standing Policy Committee for approval.

chips.text: Committee member expressed frustration with new multi-step approval process.
Committee members expressed frustration with Council's new $2,000 spending approval threshold.
Details on 2027 public art projects remain unknown for program alignment.
Program aims to support Indigenous, newcomer, and diverse emerging artists.
Staff will connect with BRT team for upcoming public art project details.
